column1: # Watson-Crick nearest-neighbour thermodynamic parameters for DNA in 1 M NaCl.
# Parameter set: SantaLucia & Hicks (2004), Annu. Rev. Biophys. Biomol. Struct.
# 33:415-440, Table 1. See README.md for how each value was verified and why
# this set was chosen over the 1997/1998 one.
# motif: 5'-XY-3' paired with 3'-X'Y'-5', written XY/X'Y'.
# dH: kcal/mol. dS: cal/(K mol) ("e.u." in the source). dG37: kcal/mol.
# Sign convention is the source's: duplex formation is exothermic, so dH < 0.
# dG37_published: SantaLucia, J. Jr (1998), "A unified view of polymer, dumbbell,
#          and oligonucleotide DNA nearest-neighbor thermodynamics", PNAS
#          95:1460-1465 (PMC19045), Table 1 column "Unified (ref. 22)"; the
#          symmetry value is from the text: "dG(sym) equals +0.43 kcal/mol ... if
#          the duplex is self-complementary". The 2004 review returned HTTP 403
#          on 2026-10-16 and could not be read. Carried here as the verifier,
#          not as an input: dH - 310.15*dS/1000 must reproduce it within the
#          rounding of the printed dH and dS (+/- 0.13 kcal/mol).
# The 1998 paper states initiation per duplex end: 0.98 for a terminal G.C and
#          1.03 for a terminal A.T. This set splits that into one initiation term
#          plus a terminal_AT term per A.T end, so the equivalent values are
#          initiation = 2 x 0.98 = 1.96 and terminal_AT = 1.03 - 0.98 = 0.05.
motif
AA/TT
AT/TA
TA/AT
CA/GT
GT/CA
CT/GA
GA/CT
CG/GC
GC/CG
GG/CC
# Non-motif terms. "initiation" is applied once per duplex. "terminal_AT" is
# applied once for each duplex end closed by an A-T pair. "symmetry" is applied
# only to a self-complementary duplex.
initiation
terminal_AT
symmetry
